body:
## What
- `hkb mcp` speaks MCP over stdio (JSON-RPC 2.0, `initialize`, `tools/list`, `tools/call`) with no dependency: implement the minimal protocol by hand.
- Each tool is a thin wrapper that calls the same functions `cli.js` uses (`lifecycle.js`, `tasks.js`); one code path, same `--json` objects.
- `hkb init --mcp` writes `.mcp.json` (`{"mcpServers":{"kanban":{"type":"stdio","command":"hkb","args":["mcp"]}}}`) and prints the equivalent for Codex (`.codex/config.toml`) and VS Code.

## Done when
`claude mcp list` / a manual `tools/list` over stdio shows the tools; a `tools/call` of `kanban_show` returns the same object as `hkb show --json`.
title: hkb mcp: stdio MCP server that wraps the CLI verbs (kanban_show, heartbeat, complete, block, request_review, comment, create, link, unblock)
